description: Machine-readable command catalog for vulcan. 63 tools across 13 groups.

groups.market: Market data: prices, orderbooks, candles, funding rates
groups.position: Position management: view, close, reduce, bracket orders
groups.margin: Collateral management: deposit, withdraw, transfer, leverage tiers
groups.history: Phoenix/Rise trader history: fills, orders, collateral, funding, PnL
groups.status: Health check, connectivity, and CLI update detection
groups.wallet: Wallet creation, address, listing, and balance
groups.portfolio: Combined portfolio snapshot in a single fetch
groups.paper: Local paper trading simulation with live prices and no real funds
groups.strategy: Curated Vulcan-owned strategy runners with tick logs and reports
groups.ta: Technical analysis: indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, BBands, ATR, VWAP, ADX, Stoch) and trigger evaluation over candle history

commands.name: vulcan_trade
commands.description: Place a market or limit order. Specify size via EXACTLY ONE of `size` (BASE LOTS — the exchange's atomic units, NOT tokens; misreading this is the #1 cause of mis-sized orders), `tokens` (base-asset amount, e.g. 0.5 SOL), or `notional_usdc` (USDC value, e.g. 100). `tokens` and `notional_usdc` work for BOTH market and limit orders — prefer them whenever you are thinking in token or USDC terms. For lot conversion: 1 token = 10^base_lots_decimals lots (see vulcan_market_info).

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market symbol, e.g. SOL

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Order side

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description: Order type. Market executes immediately, limit rests on the book.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size in BASE LOTS (exchange atomic units, NOT tokens). For a market with base_lots_decimals=2, 1 token = 100 lots. Prefer `tokens` or `notional_usdc` to avoid lot-vs-token confusion. Exactly one of size/tokens/notional_usdc is required.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Size in base-asset tokens (e.g. 0.5 SOL). Works for both market and limit orders.

parameters.name: notional_usdc
parameters.description: Size as USDC notional. For market orders, quoted at mid mark; for limit orders, divided by the limit `price` to derive tokens. Actual fill may differ from quote by spread + impact.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Limit price in USD (required for order_type=limit)

parameters.name: tp
parameters.description: Optional take-profit price

parameters.name: sl
parameters.description: Optional stop-loss price

parameters.name: isolated
parameters.description: Use isolated margin (dedicated collateral per position)

parameters.name: collateral
parameters.description: USDC collateral for isolated subaccount (requires isolated=true)

parameters.name: reduce_only
parameters.description: Order can only reduce existing position

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Must be true to confirm this dangerous operation

commands.name: vulcan_trade_multi_limit
commands.description: Place multiple post-only limit orders (bids and asks) in a single transaction. Optional per-leg `tp` and `sl` arm a take-profit / stop-loss bracket on that leg's resulting position size; when any leg carries tp/sl the submission switches to per-leg limit-order instructions bundled in one tx (slide is ignored on that path). Sizes are BASE LOTS (NOT tokens) — see vulcan_market_info for the lot-to-token conversion.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market symbol, e.g. SOL

parameters.name: bids
parameters.description: Array of bid orders. `size` is BASE LOTS (NOT tokens). Optional per-leg tp/sl prices.

parameters.name: asks
parameters.description: Array of ask orders. `size` is BASE LOTS (NOT tokens). Optional per-leg tp/sl prices.

parameters.name: slide
parameters.description: Whether orders should slide to top of book if they would cross. Default false. Ignored when any leg has tp/sl.

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Must be true to confirm this dangerous operation

commands.description: Cancel orders. `scope=ids` cancels specific orders (requires order_ids); `scope=all` cancels every open order for the market (requires symbol); `scope=all-markets` cancels every open order across every market (symbol ignored); `scope=tpsl` cancels take-profit/stop-loss bracket orders on the position (use tp/sl booleans).

parameters.name: symbol

commands.description: Check whether a newer Vulcan release is available on GitHub. Read-only: never modifies the binary. Returns current vs. latest version, a `update_available` boolean, the release URL, and an install-path-aware `update_command` hint (install.sh re-run for default/custom dirs, or 'use your package manager' for Homebrew/Nix/distro installs). commands.description: Run a TWAP strategy: market-order slices with lot-aware base-lot conversion, persisted slice ledger, and launch-time margin feasibility checks. Launch/monitoring contract: see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs). TWAP narration: every tick is a fill — report planned vs executable slice, fill, cumulative VWAP, equity, and the full transaction signature per slice.

parameters.description: Market symbol, e.g. SOL

parameters.name: notional_usdc
parameters.description: Total strategy notional in USDC

parameters.name: tokens

parameters.name: slices
parameters.description: Number of TWAP slices

parameters.name: interval_seconds
parameters.description: Seconds between slices

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: paper (Paper mode), confirm_each (Live mode with confirmation required), auto_execute (Live mode with automatic execution), or dry_run (Plan mode with dry run)

parameters.name: margin_mode

parameters.name: isolated_collateral

parameters.name: run_label
parameters.description: Optional user-visible run label

parameters.name: max_total_notional_usdc
parameters.description: Hard guardrail for total planned strategy notional

parameters.name: max_step_notional_usdc
parameters.description: Hard guardrail for per-step planned notional

parameters.name: max_price_drift_bps
parameters.description: Hard guardrail for mark-price drift from run start

parameters.name: max_exposure_ratio
parameters.description: Hard guardrail for position notional divided by equity; map user max-leverage safety input to this value

parameters.name: reconcile_attempts
parameters.description: Number of history reconciliation attempts per live step

parameters.name: reconcile_delay_ms
parameters.description: Milliseconds between reconciliation attempts

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Required for live confirm_each or auto_execute; paper and dry_run do not require it

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_grid_start
commands.description: Run a grid trading strategy: persisted level ledger, optional per-level TP/SL intent, replacement maintenance ticks, optional run-until-stopped lifecycle, stale-run detection, and local runner locking. Cross-margin uses multi-limit transactions; isolated submits individual limit orders and can transfer optional collateral on the first order. Live maintenance treats missing resting levels as filled and submits flipped replacements. Launch/monitoring contract: see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs). Grid narration: most ticks are no-fill maintenance — send a concise heartbeat per tick (do not go silent); report fills/replacements in compact tables with full tx signatures. Per-level TP/SL is intent only until a bracket action is recorded. The runner is a local process, not a daemon — if lifecycle.stale=true, stop claiming the grid is maintained and tell the user to resume/reconcile. Use vulcan_strategy_finalize for explicit cleanup.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market symbol, e.g. SOL

parameters.name: lower_price
parameters.description: Lower grid boundary price. Required unless center_on_mark is true.

parameters.name: upper_price
parameters.description: Upper grid boundary price. Required unless center_on_mark is true.

parameters.name: center_on_mark
parameters.description: Compute lower/upper from the current mark at launch. Requires width_pct. Prefer this over absolute bounds when the approval round-trip might let the mark drift outside a fixed range.

parameters.name: width_pct
parameters.description: Half-width of the grid as a percentage of mark (e.g. 1.0 = +-1%). Required when center_on_mark is true.

parameters.name: levels_per_side
parameters.description: Number of bid levels below mark and ask levels above mark

parameters.name: tokens_per_level
parameters.description: Generated level size in base tokens; mutually exclusive with size_lots_per_level

parameters.name: size_lots_per_level
parameters.description: Generated level size in base lots; mutually exclusive with tokens_per_level

parameters.name: bid_levels
parameters.description: Custom bid levels as PRICE:SIZE_LOTS[:TP][:SL]

parameters.name: ask_levels
parameters.description: Custom ask levels as PRICE:SIZE_LOTS[:TP][:SL]

parameters.name: take_profit_spacing
parameters.description: Distance from entry to TP for generated levels

parameters.name: stop_loss_spacing
parameters.description: Distance from entry to SL for generated levels

parameters.name: interval_seconds
parameters.description: Seconds between maintenance ticks

parameters.name: ticks

parameters.name: run_until_stopped
parameters.description: Keep running maintenance ticks until paused or stopped

parameters.name: stale_after_seconds
parameters.description: Seconds without a tick before status reports this run as stale; defaults to max(2 * interval_seconds, 180)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: paper, dry_run, confirm_each, or auto_execute

parameters.name: margin_mode
parameters.description: Live margin mode. Ask the user whether they want cross-margin or isolated-margin execution before launch.

parameters.name: isolated_collateral
parameters.description: Optional USDC collateral to transfer from cross-margin on the first isolated live order

parameters.name: run_label
parameters.description: Optional user-visible run label

parameters.name: slide
parameters.description: Whether live multi-limit orders may slide to top of book if crossing

parameters.name: max_total_notional_usdc
parameters.description: Max total planned grid notional

parameters.name: max_step_notional_usdc

parameters.name: max_price_drift_bps
parameters.description: Optional center-relative mark-price drift guard; grid bounds are the default price guard when omitted

parameters.name: max_exposure_ratio
parameters.description: Max position notional divided by equity

parameters.name: reconcile_attempts

parameters.name: reconcile_delay_ms

parameters.name: acknowledged

parameters.description: Return immediately with run_id; the agent enters the monitoring loop automatically (see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs))

Call this BEFORE attempting any live strategy start to avoid allocating an aborted run.

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_ta_start
commands.description: Start a TA-driven strategy run. `config` describes rules of (condition, action): each tick the runner evaluates rules top-down and the first whose composable boolean condition fires (and is not cooldown-locked) dispatches its action (open/close/reduce). Conditions compose `compare`, `crosses`, `all`/`any`/`not` over indicators, price, and constants. Reuses TWAP/grid scaffolding (run id, ledger, control IPC, pause/stop, monitor/status/wait_next_tick/report). Launch/monitoring contract: see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs). TA narration: report which rule fired (or 'no rule matched') per tick, plus the indicator values that drove the decision.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: TA strategy config with symbol, interval_seconds, rules[].

parameters.name: detached
parameters.description: Return immediately with run_id; the agent enters the monitoring loop automatically (see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs))

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Required for live modes.

commands.example: vulcan strategy ta start --config-file strategy.json --mode paper --max-ticks 60 -o json

parameters.description: Indicator-specific parameters (e.g. MACD fast/slow/signal, BBands dev_up/dev_down)

commands.example: vulcan ta compute SOL --indicator rsi --timeframe 1h --period 14 -o json

commands.name: vulcan_ta_signal
commands.description: Evaluate a technical-analysis trigger spec against the latest indicator value. Returns { fired, value, threshold, op } so agents can gate decisions on conditions like 'RSI < 30' or 'MACD histogram crosses_above 0'.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market symbol, e.g. SOL

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Trigger spec

commands.name: vulcan_ta_report
commands.description: Bundled multi-indicator snapshot (RSI, MACD, BBands, ATR, ADX) for market-intel reports. One call summarizes momentum, volatility, and trend strength.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market symbol, e.g. SOL

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Candle interval

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_resume
commands.description: Resume a paused or incomplete persisted strategy run. Live runs are dynamically treated as dangerous and require acknowledged=true plus --allow-dangerous.

parameters.name: from_step
parameters.description: Optional step index to resume from

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Required when resuming a live strategy

parameters.name: no_sleep
parameters.description: Skip sleeping between steps for recovery smoke tests
